name: MSPX430 Lens
description: MSP430X architecture and raw firmware loader.
longdescription: Adds MSP430X architecture support with LLIL lifting and a mapped raw-firmware BinaryView (ELF format works as well). Note the MSP430F5438 and MSP430F5438A devices were tested targets. It seeds memory regions, interrupt vectors, and TI header labels so raw firmware is ready for analysis. MSP430X support will become more robost in the future. Hopefully handling other specific MCUs with MSP430X ISA
